description: This file defines the KeyPreviewsManager class, which manages the display and dismissal of key preview popups in an on-screen keyboard. It handles showing previews for keys, reusing popup instances, and dismissing previews with delay.

classes.name: KeyPreviewsManager
classes.description: Manages key preview popups for an on-screen keyboard, including showing, hiding, reusing, and dismissing previews with delay.

classes.name: UIHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages delayed dismissal of key previews.

methods.name: hidePreviewForKey
methods.description: Requests dismissal of the preview for a specific key.

methods.name: showPreviewForKey
methods.description: Displays a key preview with an icon at a calculated position.

methods.name: showPreviewForKey
methods.description: Displays a key preview with a label at a calculated position.

methods.name: cancelAllPreviews
methods.description: Cancels all active previews and clears the cache.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels all previews.

methods.name: getPositionCalculator
methods.description: Returns the PositionCalculator used for positioning previews.

methods.name: internalDismissPopupForKey
methods.description: Handles internal logic to dismiss a specific key's preview.
